title: First-order equations on the singular fibre
statement: Let k be a field, f:Y -> Spec k smooth, L invertible, and s_0,...,s_r generating L with associated projective morphism an immersion, as in [def-weil-pbc-morphism-to-projective-space-by-sections]. For any affine open U on which f has smooth relative dimension d and z in U, let K=kappa(z) and F_z be the fibre of the reduced singular scheme projection from [def-zl-bertini-universal-family]. There is a surjective linear E:K^(r+1) -> K plus K^d, a commutative K-algebra A and an isomorphism F_z=Spec A, together with a surjective K-algebra quotient H:Sym_K((K^(r+1))*) -> A killing every degree-one element E*(phi). Its composite coefficient morphism to Spec k[x_0,...,x_r], with coefficients induced by U -> Spec k and variables sent to H of the coordinate functionals, is the original coefficient projection of F_z. Fibres and invertibility use [def-pc-scheme-fibre] and [def-sc-invertible-module].

source.place: Tag 0FD6, lemma-bertini, final paragraph: first-order evaluation and its kernel

proof.text: Apply the local first-jet spanning theorem to obtain a frame, the actual columns J_i, and an equivalence b from the cotangent fibre to K^d. Let T=id_K times b. Define E as T composed with the finite linear-combination map of J. The span hypothesis and Fintype.range_linearCombination make E surjective.

Apply the singular-fibre polynomial-equation theorem in the same actual local frame, obtaining its affine coordinate ring A, isomorphism e and surjective polynomial quotient q with all value/differential relations and coefficient compatibility.
Reindex the dual of the standard basis of K^(r+1) by ULift. SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial for this basis gives P with P(iota(proj_i))=x_i. Set H=q composed with P. Both maps are surjective.

Expand an arbitrary dual vector in this dual basis. Then P(iota(E.dualMap(phi)))=sum_i phi(T(J_i))*x_i. Apply the polynomial relation for phi composed with T to get zero. The equality H(iota(proj_i))=q(x_i) transports coefficient compatibility unchanged.

lean.statement:
theorem bertini_singular_fibre_equations
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) [Smooth f]
    (L : Y.Modules) [L.IsInvertible] (r : ℕ)
    (s : ULift.{u} (Fin (r + 1)) → Γ(L, ⊤))
    (hgen : Epi (L.freeHomEquiv.symm (fun i ↦
      (SheafOfModules.unitHomEquiv L) (Scheme.Modules.homOfGlobalSection L (s i)))))
    [IsImmersion (ProjectiveSpace.homOfGeneratingSections (ULift.{u} (Fin (r + 1))) f L
      (fun i ↦ (SheafOfModules.unitHomEquiv L)
        (Scheme.Modules.homOfGlobalSection L (s i))) hgen)] (U : Y.Opens) (_hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (d : ℕ) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d (U.ι ≫ f)] (z : U) :
    ∃ E : (Fin (r + 1) → (U : Scheme).residueField z) →ₗ[
            (U : Scheme).residueField z]
            (U : Scheme).residueField z × (Fin d → (U : Scheme).residueField z),
          Function.Surjective E ∧
          ∃ (A : Type u) (_ : CommRing A) (_ : Algebra ((U : Scheme).residueField z) A),
            ∃ (e : (bertiniSingularToSource f L s ∣_ U).fiber z ≅ Spec (CommRingCat.of A))
              (H : SymmetricAlgebra ((U : Scheme).residueField z)
                (Module.Dual ((U : Scheme).residueField z)
                  (Fin (r + 1) → (U : Scheme).residueField z)) →ₐ[
                    (U : Scheme).residueField z] A),
              Function.Surjective H ∧
              (∀ φ : Module.Dual ((U : Scheme).residueField z)
                  ((U : Scheme).residueField z × (Fin d → (U : Scheme).residueField z)),
                H (SymmetricAlgebra.ι _ _ (E.dualMap φ)) = 0) ∧
              e.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom
                ((algebraMap ((U : Scheme).residueField z) A).comp
                  ((U.ι ≫ f).residueFieldAlgebraMap z))
                (fun i : ULift.{u} (Fin (r + 1)) ↦
                  H (SymmetricAlgebra.ι _ _ (LinearMap.proj i.down))))) =
                (bertiniSingularToSource f L s ∣_ U).fiberι z ≫
                ((bertiniSingularToSource f L s) ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ≫
                (bertiniSingularIdeal f L s).subschemeι ≫ bertiniUniversalProjection f L s
